5844.title: [4.155] Backport the remaining 25 Skia CVE fixes
5844.body:
[4.155] Backport the remaining 25 Skia CVE fixes (#5844)

Context: #5793, #5797
Requires: mono/skia#471 (merged as `6b4b729abd0d`)
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/e6cfc7a5d6dea7e8c21a59782c672a00b1fff28c...6b4b729abd0d8cc4805d373cc6a469f8eac66655

4.155 is the last SkiaSharp line available to Uno Platform 6 apps, so
these fixes cannot be replaced by asking those users to move to a newer
line. Together with #5793 and #5797, this backport brings the 31 Skia
CVEs announced in Chrome stable releases since Chrome 156 to the 4.155
servicing line.

The native backport contains 38 upstream cherry-picks: 25 CVE fixes and
13 additional M156 hardening and test fixes. The 4.155 baseline points
to `e6cfc7a5d6dea7e8c21a59782c672a00b1fff28c`; the merged native commit
has that base and the reviewed head as parents, and its tree matches the
reviewed head. This PR updates only `externals/skia` and its matching
Component Governance pin. Public APIs, C API, bindings and package
versions are unchanged.

~~ Raster-pipeline bounds and failed shader stages ~~

Guard SkSL raster-pipeline slot counts and temporary stack-depth
arithmetic against overflow, and reject negative slot counts
(CVE-2026-118348, CVE-2026-118319). On shader-stage failure, neutralize
pending branch offsets and propagate child-shader failure so an
incomplete pipeline is not executed (CVE-2026-121084). The test conflict
was limited to M156-only context: the m155 tests remain, with the new
regression test and its required include added.

~~ Resource references during unique-key changes ~~

Keep a cache reference while changing a resource's unique key, so a
zero-refcount resource is not left in the purgeable queue
(CVE-2026-118351).

~~ Failed deferred uploads ~~

Propagate ASAP and inline upload failures through Ganesh flushes, skip
draws that could sample unwritten texture memory, and evict failed atlas
plots so cached clients are purged (CVE-2026-121072).

~~ Flush-token tracking across empty flushes ~~

Advance the token tracker even when a flush executes no draws; otherwise
per-flush atlas token comparisons can remain stale
(CVE-2026-126844). The deferred-upload reset also retains this token
advance alongside clearing the upload-failure state.

~~ Vulkan device-loss and render-pass state ~~

Treat `VK_ERROR_UNKNOWN` as device loss (CVE-2026-118354), initialize
the current render-pass pointer (CVE-2026-126915), check
`vkWaitForFences`, and apply the upstream 1 ms delay after device loss
on affected GPUs (CVE-2026-126846).

~~ Sampling outside texture subsets ~~

Nearest-filter coordinates can round outside a touching subset edge
after magnification. Retain the clamp unless the transform is a safe
1:1 integer mapping (CVE-2026-121227). Clamp coverage-mask sampling
(CVE-2026-126884) and account for AA/MSAA coordinate extrapolation when
deciding whether image-filter subset padding is sufficient. The
backport includes the nearest-subset regression test.

~~ Direct-mask Slug data and replay ~~

Direct-mask glyphs have no atlas padding when bilinear sampling is
unavailable. Reject fractional or incompatible replay
(CVE-2026-126894), and validate deserialized positions, matrices, bounds,
scales and flags before atlas sampling (CVE-2026-126922). Direct
positions must be finite integers within +/-2^21; the wire format is
unchanged. The regression tests include the protected-context case.

~~ Glyph allocation and scaler bounds ~~

Check SDF dimensions and scratch-buffer arithmetic, use fallible
allocation, and avoid rasterizing oversized glyphs that will not fit the
atlas (CVE-2026-126876). Guard the second unfiltered glyph load before it
can alias the original buffer (CVE-2026-131013). Related hardening
covers mask-filtered glyph copies and LCD16 cropping when stateful
scalers return different bounds or formats across loads.

~~ Graphite clip and stroke bounds ~~

Include hairline and subpixel strokes in clip inflation
(CVE-2026-121160), correct wedge miter inflation (CVE-2026-126841),
recognize inverse fills that cover the scissor as flood fills
(CVE-2026-126898), and use a save-record key when clip-path bounds do
not fit the packed int16 representation (CVE-2026-126857).

~~ Ganesh stroke geometry under transforms ~~

Compute op bounds in device space to match tessellator calculations
(CVE-2026-126914). Handle negative determinants when constructing
hairline square caps, and reject non-finite inverse-determinant results
(CVE-2026-126848).

~~ GPU transfer formats and channel layouts ~~

Disable unsupported BGRA-as-RGBx writes on GLES
(CVE-2026-119271). For Graphite A-to-RGBx readback, select RGBA with
forced opaque alpha so the transfer writes the expected destination
bytes (CVE-2026-126853).

~~ Cache-key comparison and hashing ~~

Compare Graphite PaintParamsKey data by byte length rather than element
count (CVE-2026-121032). Align image-filter cache equality with its
byte-based hash, including the type mask, and use float2 displacement
offsets so shader precision agrees with fp32 bounds calculations.

~~ Atlas indices under float interpolation ~~

Apply the half-step and integer conversion to Ganesh atlas indices;
flat interpolation is only a hint, not a guarantee
(CVE-2026-126920).

~~ Framebuffer lifetime on Imagination drivers ~~

Keep a complete guard FBO for the context and bind it around framebuffer
changes so a deleted FBO is not retained as the driver's previous
binding.

~~ Ganesh buffer-allocation overflow ~~

Check alignment, padding and allocation-size arithmetic; make CPU buffer
allocation fallible and bound initial preallocation.

~~ Graphite depth and painter order ~~

Reset depth and bounds tracking when an overwriting draw discards prior
draws, preventing depth wrap from changing painter order.

~~ Image-filter mipmap contamination ~~

Share mipmap downgrade logic across SpecialImage drawing paths so
unwritten scratch-texture contents do not enter filtered output. Include
the upstream regression tests and their build registration.

The native PR syntax-compiled 44 changed C++ sources under `src/` against
m155. Metal and Direct3D render-pass files were not checked locally; no
full native build or test run was performed locally.

5835.title: [4.155] Pass -sUSE_WEBGPU to Uno WASM heads only on net8.0
5835.body:
On .NET 9+ the WebAssembly block links Dawn's emdawnwebgpu port, whose
library_webgpu.js refuses to link with emsdk's -sUSE_WEBGPU. The Uno
block added that flag unconditionally, so an Uno 6.x WASM app with the
Skia renderer failed to link with "To use Dawn's library_webgpu.js,
disable -sUSE_WEBGPU". Only net8.0 (emsdk 3.1.34) still uses the
built-in WebGPU port, so add the flag only there. Main no longer has the
flag at all (the Uno block went with the Uno 7 move in #5377, and .NET 8
WASM support was dropped).

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
